name: deckysales
description: Cross-store price comparison and wishlist sale alerts for the Steam Deck store, powered by IsThereAnyDeal.

scripts.archive: pnpm run build && rm -rf DeckySales deckysales-v$npm_package_version.zip && mkdir -p DeckySales/dist && cp dist/index.js DeckySales/dist/ && cp main.py settings.py plugin.json package.json README.md LICENSE NOTICE DeckySales/ && zip -r deckysales-v$npm_package_version.zip DeckySales -x "*.DS_Store" -x "__MACOSX/*" && rm -rf DeckySales

author: zarif98
contributors: Elias (ebdevag) — original author of Deckdeals, which this is forked from
Eugene Chefranov — Russian and Ukrainian translations
